name: Tu hài
summary: Tu hài is on the 28 July 2025 special-zone eat list. The 20 June 2013 board also prints “tự hài”, “tu hài tự nhiên”, and “tu hài thường”, by the kilogram or by a count per kilogram. The 8 January 2016 article says the island’s seafood is best in winter, before the spring spawn.
howToEat: Order it by weight. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường 1/4, đường Núi Ngọc, and Bến Bèo, where the 20 June 2013 board places doors. A current door is Check on arrival. The 20 June 2013 board is a price list. A current price is Check on arrival.
